title: Agent Browser Sense Roadmap
goal: Give agents a safe browser sense for understanding websites through DOM, accessibility tree, screenshots, console and network evidence.

slice_queue.goal: Define the browser evidence object and redaction rules.
Create a client contract for dispatching browser observation jobs to the sandbox worker.
Implement domain allowlist, depth/page/time limits, robots/login policy and raw-content limits.
Run one bounded browser smoke against an approved URL and record redacted evidence.

done_definition: Browser evidence is structured and redacted.
External network is gated by approved target domain.
Screenshots and traces are artifacts, not raw prompt text.
Console and network summaries are bounded.
No browser profile or private cookies are used by default.
